Aubry Kleinsorge, Undergraduate Intern, University of Missouri-Kansas City Collaborations Formed This project significantly strengthened ties between the partner Hemlock Semiconductor Corp. and NREL. The shared IP between these two institutions on the idea ensure that there is a strong foundation of collaboration to accelerate technology transfer between a National Laboratory and an interested industrial partner. During the project NREL had multiple interactions with PVATepla, a German float zone crystallization tool maker with a US subsidiary.
